credential_file_inventory.sanitized_login_receipt_review: Contains flags, provider, outcome and timeout only; OAuth URL/code, account identity and raw terminal output are omitted.

licensing_and_notices.original_project_license: No open-source license selected; public visibility does not grant a reuse license. This is explicitly stated in NOTICE.md.
licensing_and_notices.semgrep_rules: The downloaded licensed Semgrep rule pack and unmodified raw outputs are ignored local files; no rule pack is tracked.
licensing_and_notices.standards: Catalog links and original engineering explanations are published; third-party full standards, external control workbooks and proprietary companion PDFs are not redistributed in this tree.
licensing_and_notices.third_party_source_notices: Eight pinned benchmark-project license notices are retained with the public source provenance.

limitations: A secret scanner and bounded manual review cannot prove that all secrets or private data are absent. No candidate credential was tested against a live service.

The audit covers the recorded commit, every remote branch/tag reachable at audit time, reachable history blobs/commit messages, the two recorded releases, and decoded PDF text/fields/metadata. Unreachable local Git objects, local ignored caches, GitHub Actions secrets/artifacts and unrelated external services are not publication inputs covered here.
Later file edits, new commits or changed release assets need an incremental audit.
PNG metadata was inspected; no OCR-based secret detection of raster image pixels was performed. The tracked PNGs are three brand assets and two generated report covers.
Publication licensing is recorded as repository metadata; this audit is not a legal determination or a grant of third-party rights.
privacy: Secret values, raw scanner output, author email values, personal path matches and account identities are not included. Temporary scan inputs and redacted reports were removed after inspection.
